verdict.rationale: Adyen's own docs cover the settlement side: you choose which currency you settle in, can configure multiple payout currencies per merchant account, and can get local or cross-border (SWIFT) payouts. The evidence does not show charging shoppers in their local currencies, and says nothing about how FX conversion, rates or markups are handled or disclosed. The localization evidence covers language, not currency. Missing for 10: documented multi-currency presentment/charging, transparent FX rate and markup disclosure, any conversion reporting, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can charge customers in their local currencies and settle to my bank in mine with transparent FX handling

citations.quote: Choose when and in which currency you want to settle.
You can configure multiple payout currencies for each merchant account.
Local payouts are faster and avoid SWIFT fees.
Cross-border payout: We send funds through SWIFT.
